newsitem.title: HUNGARY: NATIONAL BANK OF HUNGARY CUTS REPO RATES.
newsitem.headline: NATIONAL BANK OF HUNGARY CUTS REPO RATES.

text.p: The National Bank of Hungary (NBH) said on Monday that it had cut all its repo rates, except the overnight reverse repo rate, which remains unchanged, by 0.25 percent, with immediate effect.
"The interest rate change is in accordance with market processes," the NBH said in a statement.
The NBH said it had cut the overnight repo rate to 28.25 percent from the previous 28.5 percent.
The one-week repo rate was reduced to 28.25 percent from 28.5 percent.
The one-week reverse repo rate was cut to 22.25 percent from 22.50 percent, while the one-month reverse repo rate was reduced to 22.75 percent from 23.00 percent.

The NBH added that it also cut the interest rates used in swap deals of spot foreign currency buying and linked foreign currency futures selling, to 28.25 percent from 28.50 percent, with immediate effect.
